overview: Pre-release incremental update to the worldgen server subsystem. Major themes: (1) modding support via ModifyEvent dispatch hooks in all container and cave loaders, enabling runtime modification of biome covers, layers, prefabs, tints, environments, water, cave types, and cave prefabs; (2) ListPool-based array construction replacing fixed-size array pre-allocation for safer, more flexible JSON loading; (3) new CaveFileContext for hierarchical cave configuration referencing across zones; (4) FileContext type hierarchy refactored with RootContext sentinel, content path computation, and proper generic bounds; (5) chunk generation boundary checking to prevent out-of-bounds generation near coordinate limits; (6) cave shape geometry validation via bounds-based hasGeometry(); (7) cross-zone cave node type referencing.

new_types.overview: 4 new types added to the worldgen server subsystem.

types.name: ListPool
types.purpose: Thread-safe pooled list allocator for temporary array construction during JSON loading. Uses ConcurrentLinkedQueue with configurable capacity (default 10). Inner class Resource<T> extends ObjectArrayList and implements AutoCloseable for try-with-resources usage. toArray() returns typed array using the pool's empty array prototype. Used by all container loaders and cave loaders to replace fixed-size array pre-allocation.

types.name: CaveFileContext
types.purpose: New file context type for cave configuration hierarchies. Resolves cave paths relative to the parent ZoneFileContext's Cave/ subdirectory. Supports both name-based and explicit path construction. Used by CaveTypesJsonLoader and CavePrefabContainerJsonLoader to provide modding event context for cave modifications.
constructors: CaveFileContext(String name, Path relativePath, ZoneFileContext parentContext)

types.name: FileContext.RootContext
types.purpose: Sentinel root context replacing null parentContext. Singleton INSTANCE with id=-1, name='.', filepath=Paths.get('.'). FileLoadingContext now extends FileContext<RootContext> instead of self-referencing. Enables safe traversal up the context hierarchy without null checks.

types.name: FileContext.Registry
types.purpose: Generic named registry backed by Object2ObjectLinkedOpenHashMap. Provides register(), get(), contains(), size(). Error messages reference Constants.ERROR_MISSING_ENTRY and ERROR_DUPLICATE_ENTRY. Used within the file context system for named lookups.

modding_event_system.overview: All container and cave JSON loaders now dispatch ModifyEvent hooks after loading their entries, allowing registered event handlers to add, remove, or modify worldgen elements at load time. This is the foundation for a modding API on biome/cave configuration. Events use a SeedGenerator for deterministic seed assignment to mod-added entries. An EventHandler is acquired in ChunkGeneratorJsonLoader and released after loading completes.

changed_types.name: ChunkGeneratorJsonLoader
changes: try-with-resources now also acquires EventHandler via EventHandler.acquire(config.path())
FileContextLoader constructor now takes name parameter
FileLoadingContext created with name from config

changed_types.name: CoverContainerJsonLoader
changes: Constructor now takes BiomeFileContext parameter
Uses ListPool.Resource<CoverContainerEntry> with try-with-resources instead of fixed array
Dispatches ModifyEvents.BiomeCovers after loading entries
ModifyEvent.SeedGenerator for deterministic mod entry seeds

changed_types.name: EnvironmentContainerJsonLoader
changes: Constructor now takes BiomeFileContext parameter
Uses ListPool with EnvironmentContainer.ENTRY_POOL
mustGetArray() replaces manual has()/get() pattern
Dispatches ModifyEvents.BiomeEnvironments

changed_types.name: LayerContainerJsonLoader
changes: Constructor now takes BiomeFileContext parameter
Uses ListPool for both static and dynamic layers
mustGetArray() replaces manual has()/get() pattern
Dispatches ModifyEvents.BiomeStaticLayers and ModifyEvents.BiomeDynamicLayers

changed_types.name: PrefabContainerJsonLoader
changes: Constructor now takes BiomeFileContext instead of FileLoadingContext
fileContext derived from biomeContext.getParentContext().getParentContext()
Uses ListPool with PrefabContainer.ENTRY_POOL
mustGetArray() replaces manual has()/get() pattern
Dispatches ModifyEvents.BiomePrefabs

changed_types.name: TintContainerJsonLoader
changes: Constructor now takes BiomeFileContext parameter
Uses ListPool with TintContainer.ENTRY_POOL
mustGetArray() replaces manual has()/get() pattern
Dispatches ModifyEvents.BiomeTints
Returns ObjectArrayList instead of Collections.emptyList()

changed_types.name: WaterContainerJsonLoader
changes: Constructor now takes BiomeFileContext parameter
Uses ListPool with WaterContainer.ENTRY_POOL
Dispatches ModifyEvents.BiomeWater

changed_types.name: CaveTypesJsonLoader
changes: Creates CaveFileContext('Caves', zoneContext) in constructor
Uses ListPool with CaveType.ENTRY_POOL
loadCaveType() refactored: takes JsonObject, extracts Name internally (was external loadName())
loadName() method removed
Dispatches ModifyEvents.CaveTypes

changed_types.name: CavePrefabContainerJsonLoader
changes: Constructor now takes CaveFileContext instead of ZoneFileContext
Uses ListPool with CavePrefabContainer.ENTRY_POOL
mustGetArray() replaces manual has()/get() pattern
Child entry loader uses context.getParentContext() for zone context
Dispatches ModifyEvents.CavePrefabs

changed_types.name: BiomeJsonLoader
changes: All container loader constructors now pass biomeContext parameter
CoverContainerJsonLoader, LayerContainerJsonLoader, PrefabContainerJsonLoader, TintContainerJsonLoader, EnvironmentContainerJsonLoader, WaterContainerJsonLoader all receive BiomeFileContext

list_pool_integration.overview: All worldgen container types now have static ListPool fields for pooled array construction during JSON loading. This replaces the pattern of pre-allocating fixed-size arrays from JSON array lengths.

changed_types.name: CoverContainer
changes: New static ENTY_POOL: ListPool<CoverContainerEntry> with capacity 10

changed_types.name: EnvironmentContainer
changes: New static ENTRY_POOL: ListPool<EnvironmentContainerEntry> with capacity 10

changed_types.name: LayerContainer
changes: New static STATIC_POOL: ListPool<StaticLayer> with capacity 10
New static DYNAMIC_POOL: ListPool<DynamicLayer> with capacity 10

changed_types.name: PrefabContainer
changes: New static ENTRY_POOL: ListPool<PrefabContainerEntry> with capacity 10

changed_types.name: TintContainer
changes: New static ENTRY_POOL: ListPool<TintContainerEntry> with capacity 10

changed_types.name: WaterContainer
changes: New static ENTRY_POOL: ListPool<Entry> with capacity 10

changed_types.name: CaveNodeType
changes: New static COVER_POOL: ListPool<CaveNodeCoverEntry> with capacity 10
New static CHILD_POOL: ListPool<CaveNodeChildEntry> with capacity 10

changed_types.name: CaveType
changes: New static ENTRY_POOL: ListPool<CaveType> with capacity 10

changed_types.name: CavePrefabContainer
changes: New static ENTRY_POOL: ListPool<CavePrefabEntry> with capacity 10

file_context_refactoring.overview: The FileContext hierarchy has been significantly refactored to support content path computation, proper root traversal, and type-safe parent context references.

changed_types.name: FileContext
changes: Generic signature changed from FileContext<T> to FileContext<T extends FileContext<?>>
Fields name, filepath, parentContext now @Nonnull annotated
New transient fields: rootPath, contentPath (lazy-computed)
New methods: getRootPath() -> String, getContentPath() -> String, getRoot() -> FileContext<?>
toContentPath() static helper builds dot-separated content path from filepath relative to root
New inner class: RootContext (singleton sentinel)
New inner class: Registry<T> (named registry with Object2ObjectLinkedOpenHashMap backing)
New inner interface: Constants (ERROR_MISSING_ENTRY, ERROR_DUPLICATE_ENTRY)

changed_types.name: FileLoadingContext
changes: Now extends FileContext<FileContext.RootContext> instead of FileContext<FileLoadingContext>
Constructor takes name parameter: FileLoadingContext(String name, Path filepath)
Uses FileContext.RootContext.INSTANCE as parent instead of null
Removed self-referencing getParentContext() override

changed_types.name: FileContextLoader
changes: New name field, passed to FileLoadingContext constructor

changed_types.name: BiomeFileContext
changes: Constructor parameters now @Nonnull annotated

changed_types.name: ZoneFileContext
changes: Constructor parameters now @Nonnull annotated

chunk_generation_bounds.overview: ChunkGenerator now computes and enforces generatable area bounds based on the largest feature extents (cave sizes + prefab sizes) to prevent out-of-bounds generation near coordinate limits.

changed_types.name: ChunkGenerator
changes: New constants: CHUNK_BOUNDS_PADDING = 16, NO_CHUNK (pre-computed null CompletableFuture)
New fields: minChunkCoord, maxChunkCoord (computed from coordinate limits minus feature extents)
Constructor computes getLargestFeatureChunkExtents() across all zones' cave types and biome prefab entries
generate() returns NO_CHUNK for out-of-bounds chunks instead of scheduling async work
New method: isChunkOutsideGeneratableArea(int x, int z)
New static method: getLargestFeatureChunkExtents(ZonePatternProvider, padding) scans all cave maximumSize and prefab maxSize values

cave_system_changes.overview: Cave shape geometry validation improved, cross-zone cave type referencing added, and cave node type loading refactored for modding support.

changed_types.name: CaveNodeShape
changes: hasGeometry() changed from always-true to bounds-based: returns this.getBounds().isValid()
This delegates to IChunkBounds/IWorldBounds.isValid() which checks high > low for all axes

changed_types.name: DistortedShape
changes: Removed hasGeometry() method (was checking high > low bounds per axis)
Geometry validation now handled by CaveNodeShape via IWorldBounds.isValid()

changed_types.name: DistortedCaveNodeShape
changes: Removed hasGeometry() override that delegated to shape.hasGeometry()
Now inherits CaveNodeShape.hasGeometry() which uses getBounds().isValid()

changed_types.name: CaveGenerator
changes: New assertion: 'Cannot generate cave-prefab inside an invalid shape' before prefab placement

changed_types.name: CaveTypeJsonLoader
changes: Cross-zone cave node type referencing: strings starting with 'Zones.' are resolved by parsing the zone name from the path, looking up the ZoneFileContext, and loading from that zone's Cave/ folder
CaveNodeTypeStorage now created per-resolution instead of once upfront

changed_types.name: CaveNodeTypeJsonLoader
changes: Children loading refactored: array children now use loop-based ListPool accumulation instead of fixed array pre-allocation
Single-child JSON object case handled within same code path
Uses ListPool via CaveNodeType.CHILD_POOL

bounds_validation.overview: IChunkBounds and IWorldBounds interfaces now include validity checking and safer random offset computation.

changed_types.name: IChunkBounds
changes: New default method: isValid() returns highX > lowX && highZ > lowZ
getRandomXOffset/getRandomZOffset now delegate to new static getRandomOffset(min, max, random)
getRandomOffset() includes assertion that max > min, returns min as fallback if max <= min

changed_types.name: IWorldBounds
changes: getRandomYOffset() now delegates to IChunkBounds.getRandomOffset()
New isValid() override: extends IChunkBounds.isValid() with highY > lowY check

changed_types.name: WorldGenPrefabSupplier
changes: New getPrefabKey() accessor returning the prefab path key string
